summary: Bug fixes: on the (v3) accounts list page the per-currency totals/differences/debts are now always initialised and the saved sort settings key/default sort column are computed after the account type is known; on edit forms the 'return here to keep editing' checkbox now submits as return_to_edit (it was wrongly named create_another) and the checkbox labels are linked to their boxes.

statements.why: UI bug fixes only; no logins, money storage, data deletion or secrets involved.
True but says nothing; the change fixes the 'return to edit' checkbox (create_another -> return_to_edit).

misses.what: The 'return here to edit after updating' checkbox on edit forms was sending the wrong field (create_another), so it did not work; it now does. Labels now toggle the right checkbox.

Accounts list page (resources/assets/v3/js/pages/accounts/index.js) fix: per-currency sum/debt/difference totals are initialised correctly and remembered sorting is stored per account type (expense/revenue default to sort by name). The card doesn't mention this file at all.
